document.title: A latency comparison with a missing sample

body.value: Look for a trend, not one spike

In these synthetic observations, the busy scenario rises after the third minute while the quiet scenario stays close to its starting range. This illustrates a pattern to investigate, not a measured diagnosis.

body.title: Synthetic round-trip latency
body.note: Synthetic data. Quiet-scenario sample at 2 min is missing (null), not zero. Time labels denote minutes; latency is in milliseconds.

body.value: Use comparable measurement intervals and sources before interpreting a real change. A rising curve alone does not establish its cause.

children.caption: Original synthetic values. Empty quiet cell at 2 min denotes a missing sample.
